summary: Xometry filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing a notice of redemption for all approximately $85.0 million outstanding principal of its 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027, issued under a February 4, 2022 indenture with U.S. Bank Trust. The redemption date is November 20, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest from August 1, 2026; holders may convert until 5:00 p.m. New York time on November 19, 2026, at 17.8213 shares per $1,000 (plus 0.0018 make-whole shares), settled physically. Watch conversion-driven share dilution and noteholder election dynamics.
